subject: [Invite] Encord AI Execs Dinner @ Harvard Club Boston
text:
Hi [NAME],​

Our Head of AI will be hosting an intimate roundtable dinner with customers & AI leaders and we'd love for you to join if you're available.

We've booked a private dining room at the Harvard Club of Boston on Wednesday April 30th starting at 6:30pm, capping attendance to ~20 people. Attendees include execs from SimpliSafe, Mass General Hospital, Motorola and Vizit as well as larger orgs such as General Electric & Toyota. 

In case you're not familiar with Encord - we're a London & SF-based data development platform (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) built to help Physical AI teams get better models to market, faster. 

Thought it was a good opportunity to get connected - would you be interested in joining? I can send over an invite if so.

subject: Working w/ SponsorUnited & Relo Metrics (GumGum)
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I just read [COMPANY]'s case study w/ SageMaker about video segmentation & thought I'd reach out. text:
